title.value: NL-PS-L2 - Level 2: Narrative summaries only - Patient id query - JSON Format

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 2 test patient, in which every mandatory section has a narrative summary and an emptyReason, and no structured entries. Conformancelab searches the Patient Summary of the Patient id you enter at test setup. Enter the id of your level 2 test patient, without 'Patient/'. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ and generic building blocks (GBB) https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/
Patient.id of your level 2 test patient, without 'Patient/'.
The id of the first Patient Summary Composition in the search result.
Search the NL-PS Composition of the test patient with the Patient id entered at test setup.
Search the Patient Summary Compositions of the patient: GET [base]/Composition?type=http://loinc.org|60591-5&patient=${patient-id-2}
Confirm that the operation was successful
Confirm that the response is a searchset Bundle.
Confirm that the search result contains at least one Patient Summary Composition. Without one, step 2 cannot run.

Confirm that the search result contains exactly one Patient Summary. If there are more, step 2 uses the first one in the order of the server: check the Composition id in the request of step 2 to see which one was tested. Use a token that only gives access to one test patient to avoid this.

name.value: Retrieve and check Patient Summary document

description.value: Retrieve the NL-PS as a document Bundle with $document and check the document as a whole. Check that every mandatory section has a narrative summary and an emptyReason, and no structured entries.
Retrieve the Patient Summary as a document: GET [base]/Composition/[id]/$document
Confirm that the operation was successful
Confirm that the response is a Bundle.
Confirm that the Bundle is a document. (FHIR R4 allows a server to wrap the document in a searchset Bundle; that is not accepted here.)
Confirm that the first entry of the document is a Composition.
Confirm that the Composition is a Patient Summary (type LOINC 60591-5).
Confirm that the document conforms to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle.
Confirm that the Composition conforms to http://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/StructureDefinition/nl-PatientSummary, and through it to the EU-PS profile it imposes.
Section Problems (LOINC 11450-4): the section is present.
Section Allergies and intolerances (LOINC 48765-2): the section is present.
Section Medication summary (LOINC 10160-0): the section is present.
Section History of procedures (LOINC 47519-4): the section is present.
Section Medical devices (LOINC 46264-8): the section is present.
Section Problems (LOINC 11450-4): the section has no entries, and has an emptyReason and a narrative.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.first().resource.where($this is Composition).section.where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '11450-4').exists()).all(entry.empty() and emptyReason.exists() and text.exists())

description.value: Validate the Patient that the Composition refers to against nl-core-Patient and, as a warning, against the EU-PS Patient profile patient-eu-eps, in the document retrieved in test "Retrieve and check Patient Summary document".
Confirm that Composition.subject refers to exactly one Patient in the document.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Patient and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference or ('Patient/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference)).count() = 1

description.value: Confirm that the Patient conforms to http://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/StructureDefinition/nl-core-Patient.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Patient and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference or ('Patient/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference)).resource

description.value: Confirm that the Patient conforms to http://hl7.eu/fhir/eps/StructureDefinition/patient-eu-eps. A failure is reported as a warning.

expression.value: Bundle.entry.where(resource is Patient and (fullUrl = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference or ('Patient/' + resource.id) = %resource.entry.first().resource.subject.reference)).resource
